claims.head: The Jets like Vilardi’s line against Tkachuk’s
claims.call: The Jets’ L2 (Iafallo, Björck and Vilardi) spends at least 53% of its 5-on-5 time against the Panthers’ second line.
claims.body: At home, the Jets keep sending Vilardi’s line (Iafallo, Björck and Vilardi) out against opponents’ second lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Scott Arniel keeps choosing line for line. Tonight the Panthers’ second line is B. Tkachuk, Bennett and M. Tkachuk.
claims.nums: At home: 53% of this group’s 5-on-5 time against second lines, about 40% with no line matching
claims.gist: At home, Scott Arniel likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Panthers’ second line.

claims.head: Where the Panthers have the edge: forecheck pressure
claims.body: The Panthers are the league’s best for forecheck pressure, and the Jets are near the bottom. It’s the widest gap between these two, though not a huge one.

WPG.head: The Jets start a half-step behind
WPG.body: Florida has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately, while Winnipeg will be without Morrissey. Then again, Winnipeg has home-ice advantage, and Florida will be without Barkov. The Jets can tip it if they keep dangerous shots away.

FLA.head: The Panthers start a half-step ahead
FLA.body: Florida has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately, while Winnipeg will be without Morrissey. Then again, Winnipeg has home-ice advantage, and Florida will be without Barkov. Still, it’s close: the Jets can make it interesting if they keep dangerous shots away.

story.head: The Jets are searching for answers
paras: The Jets are winless in four (0-2-2). The Panthers are 5-4-2.
